newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Rugby Union-Otago coach backs Randell as test regular.
newsitem.headline: Rugby Union-Otago coach backs Randell as test regular.

text.p: DUNEDIN, July 28 - Otago rugby coach Glenn Ross has no doubts his captain, Taine Randell, will make it as a regular All Black test player, NZPA reports.
Randell has made a smooth transition to test rugby and he was named player of the match for his performance in the All Blacks' Bledisloe Cup-clinching win in Melbourne at the weekend.
"We never had any doubts that Taine -- whether he was wearing jersey 6, 7 or 8 - was the man for the job," Ross said.
"He's a very intelligent young man with a tremendous attitude, a wonderful personality and he's getting his just rewards."
Ross said earlier in the season doubts were expressed about both Randell and Josh Kronfeld with other players being touted as prospective test players.
"Josh had been through it before but it was a new experience for Taine and he's now getting the credit he deserves.
"He's had to endure quite a bit but, at the end of the day, he's benefited from it and probably emerged as a stronger person."
